facts.text: In 2025, Drummondville recorded more than $500 million in real estate investment, and Drummond Économique counted $188 million invested in manufacturing.

meta.descriptor: the largest city in Centre-du-Québec, between Montreal and Quebec City

overview: Drummondville had 79,258 residents in the 2021 Census, up 5.1 percent since 2016 and faster than the Quebec average. Its 36,727 occupied dwellings are spread over 247.11 square kilometres that take in the older core and former municipalities such as Saint-Nicéphore and Saint-Charles-de-Drummond.

Manufacturing drives the city: hundreds of plants operate here, and new industrial parks are being laid out to make room for more. For a local business, that means a large, working population with steady paycheques, plenty of business-to-business demand, and a growing pool of new residents moving in for jobs.
